skills.title: Machine Gun
skills.description: Damage to infantry units +55%

skills.title: Air Advantage
skills.description: Can take off within 1 hex of an aircraft carrier. Ignores the effects of any terrain type on Mobility, ignores the effects of any land mines or naval mines, and enemy forces cannot counterattack when attacking. The combat effectiveness will not go down when HP is reduced.  Damage to land units +20%.

skills.title: Evasive Maneuvers
skills.description: When attacked by the land or naval forces, there is 40% probability of dodging the damage.

skills.title: Nano-repair
skills.description: Recover 2% maximum HP at the start of the turn. Lower damage received by 15% when at full HP

levels.note:
Unlock Machine Gun
Unlock Air Advantage
Unlock Evasive Maneuvers
Unlock Nano-repair
